description: Paired per-route comparison on the 300 val routes: v0 vs Opus fair-fight runs, jpt-amz, shortest route (and rules if available). All arms re-scored with one scoring path.
split: val, 300 High routes; pilot never used; data/eval_frozen never touched
metric: official rc-cli score, lower is better; differences are first minus second (negative = first better)
scoring: v0_decode.official_scores: official unmodified evaluate(), travel times rounded to 0.1 s (raw data precision), chunks of 20 routes; same for every re-scored arm

selection.rule: fixed before val: per family, the training-data choice with the lower held-out-train loss (v0.json best_model_per_family_by_heldout_loss) and decoding beam 5 + travel at the lambda tuned on 234 held-out High train routes (v0.json tuning_on_heldout_train)
selection.best_on_val_note: lowest val mean among the 6 variants of each family (2 training sets x greedy/beam5/beam5+travel); chosen by looking at val, so optimistically biased

rules_status: included: arms ['S', 'R1', 'R2', 'R3', 'R4'] re-scored here from the stop orders stored in results/rules_baseline.json, and checked against its stored per-route scores

rules_S_vs_v0_shortest.note: two separate time-limited (10 s) OR-Tools GLS runs, so tours differ on some routes; the scoring convention is the same (rules' stored scores reproduce exactly when re-scored here)

direction.method: zone order = first visit to each zone along the arm's stop order (zone-less stops take the nearest stop's zone, as v0); Kendall tau vs the driver's zone order (v0_decode.kendall_tau)

opus_run2.predict_py_runtime: about 2.5 min wall on 3 processes for 300 routes (Opus's own APPROACH.md / final message; not timed by us) = about 0.5 s wall, roughly 1.5 CPU-s per route

opus_run1.note: no cost field (run killed before summary)

shortest.per_route: 10 s OR-Tools search per route (3 workers)

history_table.note: v0-hist and v0-hist-past look up counts from this table at predict time; it is data the model carries, beyond its 28,481 weights

settings.bootstrap: 10000 percentile resamples of routes on paired differences, seed 20261111
settings.holm: Holm step-down over the 3 main comparisons vs Opus run 2 (sign-test p)
